scope: FIRE Business App isolated candidates only
behavior: Schedule checks HTTP status and requires the estimate collection before replacing rows.
Caught failures show accessible error with Retry; previous records retained in state.
Stale job editor, route directions, overdue/upcoming cards and forecast job target hidden during loading/error; general weather remains visible.
Successful retry restores sorted jobs, same-day route addresses, revised overdue balances and edit callbacks.
testLimits: Actual ScheduleView component/hooks/load/retry/change callbacks with mocked GET and fixed time; existing financial regression uses synthetic SQLite. No hosted/mobile/weather-network proof.
priorManifest: Previous review manifests retained as historical; newer source/review inputs are not sealed.
